#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class FFT {
public:
    class Vector {
    public:
        static const int size = 1 << 20;
        long long v[size];

        Vector(const std::vector<long long>& array) {
            std::fill(v, v + size, 0);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < array.size(); i++) {
                v[i] = array[i];
            }
        }

        std::vector<long long> getFFT() {
            return computeDFT(0, 1, true);
        }

        std::vector<long long> getInverseFFT() {
            std::vector<long long> result = computeDFT(0, 1, false);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < result.size(); i++) {
                result[i] = result[i] * szInverse % mod;
            }
            return result;
        }

        std::vector<long long> computeDFT(int startIdx, int stepSize, bool forward) {
            int n = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                if (i & (stepSize - 1)) continue;
                n++;
            }
            if (stepSize == size) {
                return std::vector<long long>{v[startIdx]};
            }
            std::vector<long long> leftPart = computeDFT(startIdx, stepSize * 2, forward);
            std::vector<long long> rightPart = computeDFT(startIdx + stepSize, stepSize * 2, forward);
            int n2 = leftPart.size();
            std::vector<long long> combined(2 * n2);
            for (int i = 0; i < n2; i++) {
                long long factor = (forward ? warr[i * stepSize] : winvarr[i * stepSize]) * rightPart[i] % mod;
                combined[i] = (leftPart[i] + factor) % mod;
                combined[n2 + i] = (leftPart[i] - factor + mod) % mod;
            }
            return combined;
        }
    };

    long long mod = 998244353;
    long long w = 646;
    long long wInverse;
    long long szInverse;
    long long warr[1 << 20];
    long long winvarr[1 << 20];

    FFT() {
        wInverse = modInverse(w, mod);
        szInverse = modInverse(1 << 20, mod);
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); i++) {
            warr[i] = (i == 0) ? 1 : (warr[i - 1] * w) % mod;
            winvarr[i] = (i == 0) ? 1 : (winvarr[i - 1] * w) % mod;
        }
    }

    long long modInverse(long long a, long long m) {
        // Fermat's little theorem for prime m
        return powMod(a, m - 2, m);
    }

    long long powMod(long long base, long long exp, long long m) {
        long long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) res = (res * base) % m;
            base = (base * base) % m;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    std::vector<long long> performFFT(const std::vector<long long>& array) {
        std::vector<long long> result(1 << 20, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); i++) {
            long long val = 1;
            for (size_t j = 0; j < array.size(); j++) {
                result[i] = (result[i] + array[j] * val) % mod;
                val = (val * w) % mod;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    std::vector<long long> raiseToPower(std::vector<long long>& array, int p) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < array.size(); i++) {
            array[i] = powMod(array[i], p, mod);
        }
        return array;
    }

    void process() {
        int n, k;
        cin >> n >> k;
        std::vector<long long> arr(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int idx; cin >> idx;
            arr[idx] = 1;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); i++) {
            warr[i] = (i == 0) ? 1 : (warr[i - 1] * w) % mod;
            winvarr[i] = (i == 0) ? 1 : (winvarr[i - 1] * w) % mod;
        }
        std::vector<long long> fftResult = performFFT(arr);
        fftResult = raiseToPower(fftResult, n / 2);
        Vector vector(fftResult);
        std::vector<long long> finalResult = vector.getInverseFFT();
        long long totalSum = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < finalResult.size(); i++) {
            totalSum = (totalSum + finalResult[i] * finalResult[i]) % mod;
        }
        cout << totalSum << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    FFT fft;
    fft.process();
    return 0;
}
